images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 28 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light cool gray concrete background, no person, items only in the lower 72 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a thin silver chain necklace, a black smooth leather jacket with a short stand collar and front zip, hip length, a plain white crew-neck t-shirt, a medium shoulder bag in dark navy tonal jacquard canvas with a small subtle all-over pattern and black leather strap (no logo), dark charcoal gray washed straight-leg denim jeans with faded wash, one single pair of black leather derby shoes. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a young Korean man in his 20s wearing exactly the same items: black leather stand-collar jacket zipped halfway over the white t-shirt, the silver chain, dark charcoal washed straight jeans, black leather derby shoes, the navy patterned shoulder bag on one shoulder, walking toward camera in a quiet Seongsu-dong red brick alley in Seoul, only in the lower 72 percent, headless body-only framing cut at the collarbone, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic leather and denim textures, overcast winter afternoon soft light, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs.
